name: totr-spa

scripts.android:release: npm run android:build:linux && node shared/tools/deploy.cjs android && npm run publish:web && node shared/tools/deploy.cjs app
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:win && npm run dist:linux && npm run android:build
scripts.electron:dev:linux: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w TOTRspa_web" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm start -w TOTRspa_linux"
scripts.electron:dev:win: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w TOTRspa_web" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm start -w TOTRspa_win"

description: TOTR listener app (React) with Electron and Capacitor shells
author: the TOTR authors
